newsitem.title: USA: DT Industries files for 4.75 mln common.
newsitem.headline: DT Industries files for 4.75 mln common.

text.p: DT Industries Inc filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission on Monday for up to 4.75 million common shares.
Of the total, DT said it will offer up to 2.25 million shares while certain stockholders may offer up to 2.5 million shares.

Among the selling stockholders is Peer L.P., which plans to offer up to 1.94 million shares. The partnership currently holds a 25.1 percent stake or 2.258 million shares in the company. When the sale is complete, its stake will reduced to 2.8 percent or 317,748 shares, according to the filing.

The partnership and related entities controlled by investor Sam Fox, which currently hold 35.5 percent of DT's common stock outstanding, will collectively own a 6.2 percent stake when the offering is completed.
DT said proceeds it will receive will be used to reduce its indebtedness. It said it will not receive any proceeds from the sale by shareholders.
The offering will be made by a underwriters' group led by CS First Boston. The underwriters have an over-allotment option for up to 712,500 additional shares.

DT is a Springfield, Miss.-based designer, manufacturer and integrator of automated production equipment and systems used to manufacturer, test or package a variety of industrial and consumer products.
